title: Minimum frontage of the site (Table 2B)
text: C4.1.1 Development which complies with the dwelling type and site area provisions set out in Table 2B and the following provisions. Table 2B Site area requirements, Minimum frontage (m): R2 50; R2.5 40; R5 30; R10 20; R12.5 17; R15 12; R17.5 12; R20 10; R25 8; R30 -; R35 -; R40 -; R50 -; R60 -; R80 -; R100-SL -. Notes: R80 site area provisions apply to all single houses located on lots coded R100, R160 and LR, MR and HR. - Indicated not applicable. Min. Minimum site area. Av. Average site area.
